practice_en: limiting amino acid and AKG supplementation in fermented soybean meal diets

names: fermented soybean meal replacement plus akg
grouping.reason: All three members concern supplementing fermented-soybean-meal-for-fishmeal diets of mandarin fish with limiting amino acids (Lys, Met) and/or AKG to correct amino acid imbalance, so they are variants of one practice.

basis.summary: All four claims come from a single paper and all are supportive; C10662 and C10674 (inferred) and C10800 (claimed) carry the effect statements, while C10734 only states the study aim, and no claim gives measured values or disagreement.

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed fermented soybean meal in place of fish meal, the resulting amino acid imbalance impaired growth, feed use and protein use, and the claims say that adding limiting amino acids (lysine and methionine) eased this, and that adding AKG together with them eased the poor use of fermented soybean meal. All four claims come from one 2023 paper and none gives numbers; one only states the aim of testing AKG.
statement_zh: 鳜用发酵豆粕替代鱼粉后，氨基酸失衡会影响生长、饲料利用和蛋白利用；这些结论认为，补充限制性氨基酸（赖氨酸和蛋氨酸）可以缓解这一问题，再配合α-酮戊二酸（AKG）可改善鳜对发酵豆粕利用不佳的情况。四条结论都来自同一篇2023年的论文，没有给出具体数值，其中一条只是说明研究目的是检验AKG的作用。

basis.summary: All three claims are measured results from two 2022 papers and point the same way (hydroxyproline partly offsets the loss from replacing fish meal), with C9356 and C9383 giving the feeding evidence and C9545 marked mixed because it also reports the negative effect of the replacement itself, so I stated both together.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing 15% of fish meal with fermented soybean meal lowered growth performance, and adding hydroxyproline (1% in one paper, 1–2% in the other) offset part of this loss, with higher feed intake, weight gain and specific growth rate and better appetite. One paper also reported better muscle quality.

statement_en: One measured study (2023) found that a functional additive pack in the feed raised appetite and feed intake and promoted growth in mandarin fish. The other three papers (1998, 2024, 2024) only describe adding additives, or state aims such as easing the effects of diet change or high-sugar feed, without reporting a welfare effect.
statement_zh: 有一项实测研究（2023年）发现，饲料中添加功能包添加剂能提高翘嘴鳜的食欲和摄食量，并促进生长。其余三篇（1998年、2024年各两篇）只是介绍了添加剂的使用，或只是说明研究目的（如缓解食性转化的不良影响、提高对高糖饲料的利用），并没有给出对福利的实际效果。

Both point to a worse feeding outcome, but neither measured it in mandarin fish.

statement_en: Across these claims, keeping mandarin fish at high density in small-volume cages during feed training is said to help them take non-live feed, raising the success rate and shortening the training period, because the fish school, compete for food and imitate each other. Some claims add that this depends on good water quality and dissolved oxygen, and one adds that the fish should be kept semi-hungry; one cites 1000–2000 fish per cubic metre and another more than 50 fish per square metre.
statement_zh: 这些研究普遍认为，鳜鱼驯食时采用小体积高密度网箱，能促使鱼群聚集、争食和相互模仿，有利于摄食死饵，提高驯化成功率、缩短驯化周期。部分研究提醒，这要以水质和溶氧良好为前提，另有研究提到驯化期间要保持半饥饿状态；有的给出了每立方米1000–2000尾，有的给出了每平方米50尾以上。

statement_en: The claims disagree on how high-density farming affects feeding in mandarin fish. Some say very high stocking density (e.g. 1500 fish per mu) harms growth and feeding, and that uneven fish size or incomplete feed training in dense culture leads to cannibalism. Others say higher density can help feeding, by raising feed availability at the same ration or by encouraging competitive feeding through imitation (2500-3000 fish per cage).

statement_en: The claims point in different directions. Two claims from one paper say that raising the daily feeding rate during training of mandarin fish to accept feed caused excessive food stress, and that pushing feed amounts too high during days 14–21, a sensitive period, harmed digestive function. Two other claims, from separate papers, describe moderate or high initial feeding amounts (5–6% of body weight on days 4–9, and 40% of body weight initially) as helping fry adapt to feed, improving fish condition and reducing cannibalism.

statement_en: The claims point in different directions. Later claims describe starving fish before training, or combining short starvation with under-feeding of live bait fish, as a way to establish or speed up feeding on feed, but most of these only describe the method and do not report a clear welfare effect (one paper only says it promotes feeding and fast domestication).

None of them reports a direct welfare outcome, and one paper only states that simulating live bait and changing feeding times and frequency help training.
statement_zh: 三条来自两篇论文的结论主要是在描述鳜苗种的活饵驯化做法:投喂适口鲮鱼苗或鲜活饵料鱼,配合增氧、冲水和固定的投喂节奏,并认为有利于驯食,包括训练鱼苗在上层集中抢食。三条都没有给出直接的福利结果,其中一篇只是说模拟活饵、调整投喂时间和次数有利于提高驯食效果。

basis.summary: Only C15534 was measured and it is purely descriptive; the other three are claimed or inferred recommendations, so I summarised them as descriptions of the practice with no demonstrated welfare effect, and none of them disagree.

statement_en: The four claims all support matching bait size to the fish's growth stage, but they mostly describe the practice rather than show a measured welfare effect. They give size rules such as bait fish shorter than half the mandarin fish's body length, and one notes that live bait size may affect growth; the 60-70% and 40-50% ratios come from a related spotted mandarin fish study.
statement_zh: 四条证据都支持按生长阶段调整饵料规格，但主要是描述做法，没有实测到福利方面的效果。给出的规格要求包括饵料鱼体长要小于翘嘴鳜体长的一半，另有一条提到活饵大小可能影响鳜鱼生长；其中前期60%-70%、后期40%-50%的比例来自斑鳜的研究。

statement_en: One paper says that moving mandarin fish from live bait to other feed in gradual steps reduces their dependence on live bait, and it also notes that various training schemes have been reported with data on training period, survival or success rate. The claims give no conditions and no measured welfare outcome.
statement_zh: 有一篇论文指出,鳜鱼从活饵逐步过渡到其他饲料,可以降低它们对活饵的依赖;文中还提到不同研究报道过多种驯化方案,并给出了驯化周期、成活率或成功率的数据。不过这些说法没有给出具体条件,也没有实测的福利结果。

basis.summary: Both claims are supportive and come from different papers, so I reported them together; C15506 is measured (gut bacteria) while C2591 is only inferred (growth and acceptance), so I flagged that difference and noted there is no disagreement.

statement_en: Two papers support gradually withdrawing live bait while co-feeding artificial feed for mandarin fish: one measured that gut bacteria helpful for digesting feed increased during the shift in diet, and the other reported (inferred) better growth and greater acceptance of artificial feed in hybrid mandarin fish. Neither claim states conditions beyond the gradual withdrawal, and no disagreement or null effect is reported.
statement_zh: 两篇研究都支持鳜鱼在共投喂人工饲料的同时逐步撤除活饵：一篇实测到食性转变过程中有助于饲料消化吸收的肠道菌群逐渐增多，另一篇（推断性结论）认为杂交鳜生长改善、对人工饲料的接受度提高。两条结论均未说明除逐步撤饵以外的具体条件，也没有出现相反或无效的结果。

basis.summary: Most claims are measured but describe composition or microbiota differences rather than welfare outcomes, so I stressed the mixed and null results across several papers (S389, S491, S525, S064) and noted that digestive enzyme and growth reports conflict, including one background report.

statement_en: Studies comparing live bait with artificial feed in mandarin fish mostly measured body indices, muscle composition, gut microbiota and metabolites rather than clear welfare outcomes, and the results are mixed. Artificial feed was linked to different gut microbiota and metabolite profiles, lower muscle fat and condition factor in some papers, and no difference in liver or body size indices in others, while reports on digestive enzymes and growth point in different directions.
statement_zh: 鳜（翘嘴鳜）活饵与人工饲料的对比研究，多数测的是体指标、肌肉成分、肠道菌群和代谢物，并没有直接给出明确的福利结论，结果也不一致。投喂配合饲料后，肠道菌群和代谢物组成与活饵组不同，有的研究发现肌肉脂肪含量和肥满度较低，有的研究则显示肝体比、体型指标无差异；消化酶和生长性能方面的报道结论也不一致。

basis.summary: All the weight rests on one paper (S322) with measured results on growth, feed intake and feed conversion; C7113 is only background from another species (yellow catfish), so I left it out, and no claims disagree with each other.

statement_en: In one 90-day trial on domesticated mandarin fish in a recirculating system, a dietary LNA/LA ratio of 0.94 improved growth (weight gain, specific growth rate, body crude protein) and lowered feed conversion ratio, with the lowest feed conversion in the D3 group. Feed intake fell as the LNA/LA ratio rose, and the lowest-ratio group (D1) had the highest intake but a significantly higher feed conversion ratio than the other groups.
statement_zh: 在循环水系统中对驯化鳜鱼进行的90天试验中，饲料LNA/LA比例为0.94时，增重率、特定生长率和粗蛋白含量提高，饲料系数降低，其中D3组饲料系数最低。随着LNA/LA比例升高，摄食量下降；比例最低的D1组摄食量最高，但饲料系数显著高于其他组。

statement_en: In one study on juvenile mandarin fish, a low dietary lysine level (1.52%) was linked to reduced appetite and slow growth, while 2.58% lysine gave higher final weight and a lower feed conversion ratio than the lower-lysine groups; 2.90% was also reported to give good growth and feed use, though this last point was inferred rather than measured.
statement_zh: 在一项鳜幼鱼试验中，饲料赖氨酸水平低（1.52%）时鱼食欲下降、生长缓慢；赖氨酸水平为2.58%时，终末体重显著高于较低赖氨酸组，饲料系数也显著更低，饲料利用率更高。另有推断认为2.90%时生长和饲料利用效果较好，但这一点不是直接测得的。

basis.summary: Most weight goes to the measured claims from three mandarin fish papers (S416, S359, S379) showing higher feed conversion ratio and lower survival, with S379 showing no survival effect in large fish; the inferred mechanism claims are flagged as inference, and the rainbow trout background claims (S380) were left out as a different species.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, low-protein diets (about 29–40% protein, depending on the study) mostly worsened feeding-related outcomes: feed conversion ratio was higher, and survival was lower in small and medium-sized fish; in large fish, survival was not affected, and digestibility was lower only at 35% protein. One study also found lower brain expression of the appetite genes agrp and npy in the low-protein group, while other appetite genes did not change; explanations about impaired digestion and cell turnover are the authors' inferences.
statement_zh: 在鳜上，低蛋白日粮（各研究约29%–40%蛋白）总体上让摄食相关指标变差：饲料系数升高，小规格和中规格鳜的存活率下降；大规格鳜存活率不受影响，仅在35%蛋白时消化率偏低。有一项研究还发现低蛋白组脑中agrp和npy表达降低，其他食欲基因无变化；消化障碍、细胞更新受阻等解释是作者的推断。

basis.summary: Both claims are labelled counterevidence and point the same way, so there is no disagreement; C7353 carries more weight because it was measured, while C3511 is only a claimed explanation for low feed intake, and each comes from a different paper.

statement_en: Two papers from 2019 point to harm from low-protein, high-carbohydrate or lipid diets in mandarin fish. One suggests that low protein with high carbohydrate/lipid may explain low feed intake and poor palatability, though this was claimed rather than measured. The other measured that fish in group A had significantly lower weight gain, specific growth rate and protein efficiency ratio than groups B and C.
statement_zh: 两篇2019年的研究都显示，低蛋白、高碳水或高脂日粮对鳜鱼不利。一篇认为低蛋白加高碳水/脂质可能是采食量低、适口性差的原因，但这只是推断，并非实测；另一篇实测发现A组鳜鱼的增重、特定生长率和蛋白质效率比显著低于B组和C组。

statement_zh: 在鳜鱼养殖中，低糖高脂（糖脂比0.12）的饲料导致生长速度显著低于较高糖脂比（1.71）的饲料。

practice_zh: 投喂量与投喂频率调整

statement_en: Two papers describe adjusting feeding for mandarin fish: cutting to one feeding a day when water below 15°C clearly weakens feeding, and reducing the amount fed during weather changes, medication, poor water quality or disease. Both are stated as supportive practice advice, and neither claim reports a measured welfare outcome.
statement_zh: 两篇文献提到鳜鱼投喂的调整做法：水温低于15℃、摄食明显减弱时，每天只投喂1次；遇到天气变化、用药、水质恶化或发病时，适当减少投喂量。两条都只是支持性的做法说明，没有给出实际测得的福利效果。

practice_en: lysine and methionine supplementation in diet
practice_zh: 饲料中添加赖氨酸和蛋氨酸

grouping.reason: Members 0, 1 and 3 all concern supplementing crystalline lysine and/or methionine in mandarin fish diets, whereas member 2 is about amino acid deficiency (a diet lacking them), not a supplementation practice, and C10732 is a general statement about amino acid deficiency and AMPK signalling.

strength.en: All 10 claims come from one paper.
strength.zh: 全部 10 条论断来自同一篇论文。

basis.summary: All claims come from one paper (S417); the measured claims carry most weight and show that the combined addition helped while methionine alone hurt, so I reported this disagreement and flagged the excess-methionine explanation as inferred, leaving out the general background claims.

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed plant-protein diets, adding lysine and methionine together improved growth, feed conversion and protein retention and eased the amino acid imbalance, while methionine alone worsened these measures and lysine alone gave lower feeding rate than methionine alone. Both amino acids individually altered brain appetite genes (npy, agrp) without a significant interaction; the poorer result with methionine alone is only inferred to come from excess methionine.
statement_zh: 鳜用植物蛋白饲料时，同时添加赖氨酸和蛋氨酸可提高特定生长率和蛋白质保留率、降低饵料系数，并缓解氨基酸不平衡；单独添加蛋氨酸反而使这些指标变差，单独添加赖氨酸的摄食率则显著低于单独添加蛋氨酸。两种氨基酸单独添加都会影响脑中npy和agrp基因表达，但交互作用不显著；单加蛋氨酸效果变差只是推测可能因蛋氨酸过量。

strength.en: All 2 claims come from one paper.
strength.zh: 全部 2 条论断来自同一篇论文。
strength.rule: one paper; described if more claims describe than take a side; agree or against at 80% or more one way; otherwise mixed

basis.summary: Both claims come from a single paper; C10731 is measured and carries the most weight, showing mixed effects with no net change in intake, while C10732 is only inferred and descriptive, so I reported it as a mechanism without a welfare effect.

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed lysine- or methionine-deficient diets, the amino acid response pathway suppressed feeding, but hunger signals (high npy and agrp expression) offset this, so final feed intake did not differ significantly. The other claim only describes how amino acid deficiency upsets energy balance and activates AMPK signalling, and does not report a welfare outcome.
statement_zh: 鳜摄食缺乏赖氨酸或蛋氨酸的饲料时，氨基酸反应（AAR）通路会抑制摄食，但饥饿信号（npy、agrp高表达）起到抵消作用，最终摄食量没有显著差异。另一条结论只是说明氨基酸缺乏会打乱体内能量平衡并激活AMPK信号通路，并未给出对福利的具体影响。

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed maggot meal in place of fishmeal with added taurine, one paper measured higher expression of the appetite-stimulating genes npy and ghrelin and lower expression of the appetite-suppressing gene pomcα, which the authors suggest may improve feeding motivation. The same paper also proposes, without direct testing, that the combination may raise hunger-driven behaviour and feed palatability.
statement_zh: 在用蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉并添加牛磺酸的鳜鱼中，一篇研究测到促食欲基因npy和ghrelin表达升高、抑食欲基因pomcα表达下降，作者认为这可能提高摄食动机。该研究还推测这种组合可能增强饥饿驱动的摄食行为、改善饲料适口性，但这一点没有直接验证。

basis.summary: Of 13 claims from 12 papers most are descriptive or only claimed, so I gave most weight to C13092 (mouth-refusal/death solved), C13830 (no growth loss, though inferred) and the measured growth results C7002 and C6830; no claims conflict.

statement_en: Most claims only describe the formulated (mostly extruded) feed used for mandarin fish; the ones that report an effect are positive. statement_en: The three claims agree that catching causes injury to mandarin fish fingerlings and that gentler methods help. One paper infers that unnoticed injuries during catching may explain deaths in the first week after the fish are put into cages and the low survival. Another says cutting the netting free, rather than pulling fish out, avoids mechanical damage that affects survival. A third says traditional seine netting causes considerable harm, while ground cages or small maze traps are better and do not injure the fish.

statement_en: Both claims describe a low-stress grading procedure for mandarin fish (skipping one feed and checking health beforehand, grading only disease-free and active fish, working in water with enough oxygenation, and letting fish pass through the sorter on their own) and say it is meant to reduce stress. Neither claim gives a measured welfare outcome such as stress indicators or survival, so the effect itself is not shown here.
statement_zh: 两条结论都只是介绍鳜鱼低应激分筛的做法：分筛前停喂一顿并检查健康，只在鱼苗无病、活力好时进行，带水作业、充分增氧，并引导鱼自己过筛，目的是减少应激。但这两条都没有给出应激指标或成活率等具体的福利结果，所以实际效果在这里并没有得到体现。
